title: From Pune to Delhi: protest organisers allege detentions ahead of october 10 rally
description:
With just one day remaining before the proposed October 10 protest in Delhi, organisers including the Cockroach Janta Party, AISF and SFI have alleged that activists and students are being detained or questioned across multiple states.

Student groups claim protesters travelling to Delhi have been stopped in places including Madhya Pradesh, while organisers allege detentions, police visits and questioning of activists’ families in several states. Meanwhile, Delhi Police have intensified security preparations, increased deployments and are monitoring mobilisation efforts ahead of the planned demonstration.

As both sides present sharply different accounts, attention is turning to whether protesters will be able to reach Delhi and how authorities will respond on October 10.

This initiative is modelled after the successful US Defense Logistics Agency's operational framework. The Department of Military Affairs is actively working on incorporating best practices suitable for the Indian context. Various committees are being formed to streamline logistics processes and procedures across services.

His actions led to the targeted elimination of more than 300 Russian soldiers and deliberate sabotage of weapons systems, culminating in his flight to the Russian Volunteer Corps as a direct challenge to Putin's leadership. Stupnikov’s bravery reshaped the landscape of the ongoing Ukraine conflict.
